title: Klippo Master Product-Specific Video Prompt Library
usage_notes: All curated prompt templates are stored in this version-controlled GitHub JSON library and loaded by Klippo; templates are not invented randomly at runtime.
Prompt generation is text-only. No uploaded image or AI image analysis is used. Product subtype and category are inferred from words in the supplied product name or the user's selected category.
Every prompt is a complete, copy-ready block of text with its own premium four-beat storyboard. Each concept has a distinct signature action, detail shot and closing composition.
No on-screen text, captions, added logos or watermarks. Each storyboard prompt is exactly 10 seconds, vertical 9:16.
For 20-second requests, Klippo delivers two separate complete 10-second prompt texts; Part 2 begins from Part 1's held final frame and uses a complementary action rather than repeating the opening.
Templates avoid unsupported specifications, benefits, ingredients, materials, accessories and performance claims.
External video generators may interpret prompts differently; Klippo stores and selects prompts but does not guarantee the output of external generators.

prompts.label: Walking OOTD
prompts.description: Model berjalan secara semula jadi untuk menunjukkan keseluruhan pakaian dan jatuhan kain.
prompts.prompt:
Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 product advertisement for the product name supplied by the user, in the Pakaian category. Creative direction: Model berjalan secara semula jadi untuk menunjukkan keseluruhan pakaian dan jatuhan kain. Keep the named product as the clear hero. Use plausible generic visuals and natural camera movement. REFERENCE LOCK: Use the uploaded image as the MASTER visual reference and sole source of truth for the product's visible identity. Preserve the exact shape, proportions, colors, pattern, packaging, visible branding and every visible component. Do not redesign, recolor, add or remove features, invent unseen sides or replace the product. The product name and optional written details are supplementary context and must never override the reference image. Do not invent exact materials, specifications, features, compartments, included accessories, product benefits, brand marks or labels that are not stated in the product name. STRICT OUTPUT RULES: exactly 10 seconds, vertical 9:16, one cohesive product video, no on-screen text, no captions, no added logos, no watermark, no morphing, no floating objects, no unrealistic transformations. Keep the product presentation consistent and finish with a clean hero frame.
